summary: Comprehensive testing of new Team Chat & Task Management features. Backend: 17/17 tests passed (100%). Frontend: All features working correctly including compact module grid, tasks panel, chat page with conversations, messages, and proper role-based access control.

issues: Console warning: 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>' - This is a React hydration warning in the assignee dropdown. The dropdown works but has invalid HTML structure.

action_items: Minor: Fix the assignee dropdown in HubPage.js - the option elements contain span children which is invalid HTML. Change line 313 from using template literal with span to just plain text content.
critical_code_review_comments: Chat API correctly uses token as query parameter (?token=...) for all endpoints
Group creation properly restricted to admin users (403 for non-admin)
Direct conversation deduplication works correctly - returns existing conversation if already exists
File attachments work via FormData with multipart/form-data
Tasks have proper priority ordering (high=0, medium=1, low=2) for sorting
Task filters correctly implemented: 'mine' shows assigned tasks, 'created' shows created tasks, 'all' is admin-only
Hub page redesigned from full-width cards to compact icon grid - looks clean and professional
Tasks panel integrated on right side of Hub page with proper filtering
Chat page has proper layout: conversation list on left, messages on right
Messages display with sender name, timestamp, and checkmarks for sent status
Non-admin users correctly cannot see 'Gruppe' button or 'Alle' task filter
test_credentials: Admin: admin@test.com / password, Mitarbeiter: ma1@test.com / password
seed_data_creation: Created test conversations, messages, and tasks during testing (prefixed with TEST_)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Team Chat & Task Management features fully tested. Chat uses /api/chat/* endpoints with token query param. Tasks use /api/chat/tasks endpoints. Hub page has compact module grid (2-4 columns) with tasks panel on right. Chat page accessible via /chat route. Admin can create groups, non-admin cannot. Task filters: mine/created for all users, 'all' for admin only.
